class.name: ScriptFunctionState
class.brief_description: Abstract base type for native coroutine handles returned by async FoundryScript calls.
class.description: [ScriptFunctionState] is the engine-level contract for a suspended async function. FoundryScript's runtime coroutine handle derives from this type. Native hosts that resume or await script coroutines outside the VM should detect the handle with [code]Object::cast_to()[/code] and listen for the [signal completed] signal rather than depending on module-specific types.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted when the suspended function finishes. [param result] carries the coroutine's return value, or [code]null[/code] when the function failed at runtime.
